on:

    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the

      - dependabot/**

    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests

          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

on:

      - dependabot/**

    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"

        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

**General Guidelines for Java Projects**

1. **Read the README**  
   Start by reading the project's README file on GitHub. It often contains important instructions for installation, usage, and any project-specific details.  

2. **Check Dependencies**  
   Look for any dependencies listed in the README or in configuration files like `pom.xml` (for Maven) or `build.gradle` (for Gradle). Ensure you have the required JDK version installed.  

3. **Build Tool**  
   Identify which build tool the project is using: Maven or Gradle. This information should be available in the README or through project configuration files (`pom.xml` for Maven, `build.gradle` for Gradle).  

4. **Build the Project**  
   Use the appropriate commands based on the build tool:  
   - For Maven:  
     ```  
     mvn clean install  
     ```  
   - For Gradle:  
     ```  
     gradle build  
     ```  

5. **Configuration**  
   Check if the project requires any configuration files (e.g., property files, YAML files) and set them up accordingly.  

6. **Run Tests (if available)**  
   If the project provides tests, it’s a good idea to run them to ensure everything is working correctly.  

7. **Run the Project**  
   Follow the instructions in the README to run the project. This could involve running a specific class, starting a server, or executing a specific command.  

8. **Troubleshooting**  
   If you encounter any issues during installation or while running the project, refer to the project’s issue tracker on GitHub or search for similar issues others may have encountered.  

9. **Test Suite Results**  
   When running a test suite, it is normal for some test cases to fail. If the percentage of failing test cases is less than 20% of the total number, it is considered acceptable, and further investigation is usually not necessary.

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:

          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:

          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests

        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |

FROM openjdk:8

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other necessary packages
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y maven && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/google/gson.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/gson

CMD ["/bin/bash"]

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

on:

      - dependabot/**

  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2

          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

on:

    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1

          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

FROM openjdk:8-jdk

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other necessary packages
RUN apt-get update && \

      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

on:

      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests

          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:

    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**

  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"

          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility

FROM ubuntu:20.04

# Check connectivity
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl && curl -I https://registry-1.docker.io

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install necessary packages
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y openjdk-11-jdk maven git && \
    apt-get clean && \

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

**General Guidelines for Java Projects**

1. **Read the README**

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"

      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"

        with:

          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5

          cache: 'maven'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      # Ignore Dependabot branches because it will also open a pull request, which would cause the
      # workflow to redundantly run twice
      - dependabot/**
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read #  to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build on JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ 11, 17, 21 ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build with Maven
        # This also runs javadoc:jar to detect any issues with the Javadoc generated during release
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify javadoc:jar

  native-image-test:
    name: "GraalVM Native Image test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up GraalVM"
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@7f488cf82a3629ee755e4e97342c01d6bed318fa  # v1.3.5
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'graalvm'
          # According to documentation in graalvm/setup-graalvm this is used to avoid rate-limiting issues
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build and run tests
        # Only run tests in `test-graal-native-image` (and implicitly build and run tests in `gson`),
        # everything else is covered already by regular build job above
        run: mvn test --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --activate-profiles native-image-test --projects test-graal-native-image --also-make

  verify-reproducible-build:
    name: "Verify reproducible build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
      - name: "Set up JDK 17"
        uses: actions/setup-java@c5195efecf7bdfc987ee8bae7a71cb8b11521c00  # v4.7.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: 'maven'

      - name: "Verify no plugin issues"
        run: mvn artifact:check-buildplan --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress

      - name: "Verify reproducible build"
        # See https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-reproducible-builds.html#how-to-test-my-maven-build-reproducibility
        run: |
          mvn clean install --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests
          # Run with `-Dbuildinfo.attach=false`; otherwise `artifact:compare` fails because it creates a `.buildinfo` file which
          # erroneously references the existing `.buildinfo` file (respectively because it is overwriting it, a file with size 0)
          # See https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MARTIFACT-57
          mvn clean verify artifact:compare --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dproguard.skip -DskipTests -Dbuildinfo.attach=false
